Last Saturday, Tom and Sam went to the kitchen. The kitchen is one of the best places in the city. Tom is going to travel to Paris in March. Best of all, raise your arm, please.
They took many photos at the family chat. Tom bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. Both of them like salad and water. Add one chilli for extra heat.
Tom drinks water after doing sports. Tom thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Tom learned a lot about English. In fact, tom is my best friend.
Tom and Sam had great fun there. There are always many people at the family chat. Tom wrote about the day in the diary.
